rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance (2026 adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance for an owner move-in eviction. Effective January 1, 2026, the standard payment increases to $19,413, and the additional payment for qualifying households increases to $6,471.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (1.5% upward adjustment)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted for owner move-in under the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; additional payment for qualifying households
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.effective_date_phrase: will go into effect on January 1, 2026

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners removing a property from the rental housing market must pay evicted tenants the same relocation assistance as for owner move-in evictions. Effective January 1, 2026, the standard payment increases to $19,413, and the additional payment for qualifying households increases to $6,471.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (1.5% upward adjustment)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market under the Ellis Implementation Ordinance; additional payment for qualifying households
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.effective_date_phrase: will go into effect on January 1, 2026
